name: Misery Stentrem
original_name: ミズリィ・ステントレーム
source:
A wicked witch and matriarch of the dark elves, she serves as their advisor and is a woman of few words.
Despite how she may look and dress – she is virgin. She falls madly in love with the protagonist at first sight.

[spoiler]2546 years old.[/spoiler]
